questions.question_text: The expression for rms voltage of an AC sinusoid is given by
questions.answer: For a pure sinusoidal AC waveform, the Root Mean Square (RMS) value is always the peak voltage (Vm) divided by the square root of 2.

questions.question_text: The law proposed by ohm is relevant in condition with
questions.answer: Ohm's Law states that current is directly proportional to voltage, provided physical conditions like temperature remain strictly constant.

questions.question_text: In a pure inductive circuit (L), the current _______ by a voltage of 90 degree.
questions.answer: In an ideal purely inductive AC circuit, the current lags the applied voltage by an exact phase angle of 90 degrees.

questions.question_text: According to superposition theorem, while considering an individual source, all other voltage sources can be .
questions.answer: In Superposition Theorem, when analyzing the effect of one source, ideal voltage sources are deactivated by being short-circuited (0 V).
Standard PN junction diodes are two-terminal devices without a control gate, making them the main component of uncontrolled rectifiers.

questions.question_text: The voltage controlled semiconductor device is
questions.answer: Unlike BJTs which are current-controlled, a MOSFET operates by adjusting the channel conductivity using the voltage applied to the gate terminal.

questions.question_text: The logical expression Y=AB+AC is known as
questions.answer: Y=AB+AC features product terms (AND operations like AB, AC) that are summed (OR operation) together, fitting the definition of Sum of Product (SOP) form.

questions.question_text: The input X-NOR gate gives high output
options: When one input is high and other is low
Only when both inputs are low
Only when both the inputs are high
questions.answer: An EX-NOR (Exclusive-NOR) gate acts as an equivalence detector, yielding a high output ('1') only when its inputs match exactly.

questions.question_text: The material used for the yoke of a DC machine is to provide a
questions.answer: While the yoke also serves as an outer mechanical cover, its functional electromechanical purpose is to provide a low-reluctance return path for the magnetic flux.

questions.question_text: Rotor windings are not present in
questions.answer: A Squirrel cage induction motor utilizes solid aluminum or copper conductor bars shorted by end rings instead of traditional wound coils on the rotor.

questions.question_text: Which of the following motor is more suitable for EV applications?
questions.answer: Brushless DC (BLDC) motors (along with PMSMs) provide high power density, reliability, and excellent efficiency, making them a premier choice for Electric Vehicle (EV) propulsion.

questions.question_text: In LVDT, when the iron core is exactly at centre, then net output of transducer is
questions.answer: When the core of an LVDT is exactly at the geometric center (null position), the induced voltages in the two identical secondary coils cancel each other perfectly, giving zero net output.

questions.question_text: Which type of transducer is most commonly used in testing of structural load bearing limitations?
questions.answer: Strain gauges measure mechanical deformation or strain caused by forces, making them the standard tool for structural load and stress testing.

questions.question_text: The current flow in photodiode when light fall on its junction is called
questions.answer: The current generated in a semiconductor device purely as a result of incident photons creating electron-hole pairs is explicitly termed 'photo current'.

questions.question_text: Which transducer is used for light spectrum detection?
questions.answer: A photo transistor is an active light-detecting sensor that converts light photons into a corresponding electrical signal.

questions.question_text: Earth wire is made up of
questions.answer: For overhead transmission lines and general robust grounding applications, Galvanized steel (GI) is commonly used for earth wires because of its high tensile strength and rust resistance.

questions.question_text: Solar efficiency will be commonly in the range of
questions.answer: Standard commercial silicon-based solar photovoltaic panels typically operate at an energy conversion efficiency of roughly 15% to 22%.

questions.question_text: The most widely used material for solar cell fabrication is
questions.answer: Due to its suitable bandgap, abundance, and extensive manufacturing infrastructure, Silicon is overwhelmingly the dominant material for solar cell fabrication.

questions.question_text: The predominant material used for PV cell manufacturing is
questions.answer: Crystalline silicon dominates the Photovoltaic (PV) industry market as the primary semiconductor material.
